rationale: The plan correctly identifies the question as a condition-by-time interaction and encodes time as a 4-level factor with explicit reference levels, per-timepoint simple effects, and trajectory reporting, which fits the 2x4x3 design well. However it never runs the joint test the reference specifies: there is no LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time against ~condition+time, only separate Wald tests on each interaction coefficient with an informal 'significant on any coefficient' rule, which is neither a proper joint test nor multiplicity-controlled across the three coefficients; this also leaves the GSEA ranking metric vague ('aggregate or representative' Wald statistic, which does not exist without an LRT). QC (VST PCA by condition and time, distance heatmap, library sizes, outlier flagging, metadata cross-tab catching the 25-vs-24 sample discrepancy), the minimal count>=10 in >=smallest-group filter, in-model median-of-ratios normalization with no pre-normalization, BH at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage, and preranked fgsea against versioned Hallmark/Reactome with a 15-500 size window and leading edges are all explicit and appropriate. The final report section is thorough on versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, diagnostics, and reproducibility; the main gaps are the missing reduced-model LRT and any statement of design caveats such as low n=3 per cell and no batch structure.
